dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Browns (6-4) Week 12 Briefing: Wednesday Injury Report Ahead of Raiders
bullets: Injury & Practice Status: Cleveland opened DT Kalia Davis's 21-day IR practice window alongside limited work for TE Harold Fannin Jr. (groin), TE Blake Whiteheart (hip), and C Elgton Jenkins (knee). DE Isaiah McGuire (calf), DE Derek Barnett (hamstring), OT Austin Barber (knee), and WR Denzel Boston (quad) did not practice Wednesday, while S Ronnie Hickman (concussion) practiced in full [clevelandbrowns.com Official](https://www.clevelandbrowns.com/news/browns-offense-aims-to-build-on-recent-pass-game-production-in-week-12).

Week 12 Raiders Outlook: Todd Monken and DC Mike Rutenberg open installation for the Las Vegas Raiders (4-7, CLE -4.5, HC Klint Kubiak, OC Andrew Janocko & DC Rob Leonard (Huntington Bank Field))—a unit ranked #1 in Kickoff Return Average (29.1 yds) as Cleveland prepares for a pivotal AFC matchup [Chris Pokorny](https://www.dawgsbynature.com/cleveland-browns-game-information/138993/las-vegas-raiders-vs-cleveland-browns-week-12-tv-map) [Jared Mueller](https://www.dawgsbynature.com/cleveland-browns-news/138989/browns-raiders-week-12-injuries-denzel-boston-austin-barber).

AFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 6-4 (3rd in AFC North • #6 Seed in AFC), Cleveland carries a 61.7% postseason projection, 14.7% AFC North division title mark, and 0.1% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [Thomas Moore](https://www.dawgsbynature.com/cleveland-browns-news/138966/cleveland-browns-news-the-afc-north-is-a-wacky-and-wild-place).

Around the Beat: Browns' offense aims to build on recent pass game production in Week 12 [clevelandbrowns.com Official](https://www.clevelandbrowns.com/news/browns-offense-aims-to-build-on-recent-pass-game-production-in-week-12).
